meta.description: Gene Ontology over-representation analysis of a selected gene list using clusterProfiler enrichGO, with explicit background-universe selection, ID conversion, GO-DAG redundancy handling, and an optional GOseq length-bias branch.
meta.environment: Private WSL runtime /home/sci/openscience-go-audit-20260923; R 4.4.3; clusterProfiler 4.14.0; org.Hs.eg.db 3.20.0; GOSemSim 2.32.0; goseq 1.58.0; geneLenDataBase 1.42.0. Created only after the shared Windows R wrapper orphaned the all-ontology child process; shared environment was not modified.
meta.audit_type: Phase 2 final-pass audit of the exact requested source tip. The previous canonical JSON and viewer were archived at F:\OpenScience\audits\_pre-fix-20260923\bio-pathway-go-enrichment\ before this report was written.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md
meta.execution_note: All dynamic probes were executed in the private WSL runtime. Per the canonical-report-only instruction, transient runner output was not archived; all outcomes and exact versions are recorded below. The source worktree remained untouched.

scientific_integrity.detail: Executed results use only local, versioned GO annotations. The foreground/universe membership used for audit probes is synthetic and labeled as such; no clinical or individual-level claims were made.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill frames ORA as hypothesis generation and routes ranked-list analyses to GSEA.

methodological_ground.detail: The explicit-universe, adjusted-p, FoldEnrichment, per-ontology simplification, groupGO, ID-conversion, and custom-enricher claims reproduced on the pinned isolated stack.

code_usability.detail: The GOseq code block was executed verbatim after installing both its documented dependency (goseq 1.58.0) and geneLenDataBase 1.42.0. nullp(de_genes, 'hg38', 'ensGene') reported that no hg38/ensGene length data were available, attempted a UCSC download, then halted: 'Length information for genome hg38 and gene ID ensGene is not available. You will have to specify bias.data manually.' The Skill neither declares this additional TxDb/bias.data requirement nor supplies a runnable fallback.

functional_suitability.note: Core ORA, all-ontology, ID-conversion, redundancy, and custom-set paths are runnable; the advertised RNA-seq GOseq path is not.

reliability.note: Strong explicit-universe and conversion-loss guidance, but no preflight for the GOseq length-data dependency or fallback bias.data path.

performance_context.note: The examples are self-contained and complete; simplify() cost scales sharply with an unfiltered all-ontology result, which the normal thresholded examples avoid.

agent_usability.note: Clear execution order and failure modes; the runnable-looking GOseq fence is a misleading dead end on the declared dependency set.

human_usability.note: Readable prompts, result-column definitions, and caveats; the missing GOseq prerequisite is material.

security.note: No credentials or destructive operations; local OrgDb route is safe. The failing GOseq route attempts a network download without saying so.

maintainability.note: Self-contained shipped examples and explicit package-version guidance are strong. The GOseq integration needs a verified, version-pinned data source.

agent_specific.note: Good routing boundaries and explicit statistical defaults, reduced by an optional branch that cannot execute as written.

findings.title: GOseq length-bias code fence is not runnable from its documented prerequisites
findings.problem: The code calls nullp(de_genes, 'hg38', 'ensGene'), but the documented installation installs only goseq. Even with geneLenDataBase explicitly installed, the isolated current stack reports no hg38/ensGene length data and halts before goseq/BH correction.
findings.impact: RNA-seq users following the advertised correction path receive a runtime failure or an undeclared network-dependent retrieval attempt instead of a length-bias-aware analysis.
findings.recommended_fix: Provide and verify one complete, version-pinned route: declare the exact TxDb/length-data package and compatible identifier namespace, or show an explicit bias.data input with a checked fallback. Add a preflight that fails clearly before attempting the analysis.

final.summary: Core ORA and the corrected simplify(ont='ALL') behavior pass, but the advertised GOseq code path is a reproducible code-usability failure on the declared/current dependency stack.
